source: Separate independent automated read-only bridge specialist; scoped verdict and findings supplied to the integrator on 2026-10-13 UTC.

reported_test_results.interpretation: Specialist-reported counts retained separately; the publisher does not combine them with worker suite counts or claim to have observed the specialist's executions.

findings.finding: Git status can hide changed tracked bytes under assume-unchanged or skip-worktree.
findings.resolution: Current README, bridge contract, publication notice and round report explicitly state the index-dependent Git-status boundary; strict dependency byte-cleanliness is not claimed.

findings.finding: Coherently rehashed saved packages can retain boolean exit codes, noncanonical timestamps, negative PIDs or malformed recorded working directories.
findings.resolution: Current documentation explicitly states the incomplete strict process-field gate. Saved intake grants no fresh pass; recheck still regenerates source from original JSON and executes fresh trusted Lean gates.

scoped_acceptance: No normalization, injection or stale-output path yielding false fresh Lean acceptance was found within the documented parser/cache trust.
remaining_obligations: Strict dependency tracked-byte checking in the LP bridge
Strict type/consistency validation of all LP saved-process fields
Formal parser/literal refinement, finder completeness and strong duality
Full dependency-cache rebuild or independent kernel
